title: At Seven, in the Dark, for Thirty-One Years
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：task　|　正文 390 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 task 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When I was eleven my teacher set us a ① task for the summer: a notebook of one thing you did for somebody else, one line a day, ninety lines, and the task was the same every year. Most of the class wrote ninety lines in the last week and my teacher knew it, because the ink was the same colour on all ninety. Mine was different because my father made me do it, and he checked it every night at six.

My father's own ② task, as he saw it, was the school building, and he was its caretaker for thirty-one years. In the winter of 1987 the roof went, and getting it fixed before term started was, everybody said, an ③ impossible task: eleven weeks, no money, and a council that answered nobody. He said the task was not the roof but the council, and he did it in nine weeks by writing to them eleven times and then standing in the office.

He never called it a ④ task, which was the word my mother used for it; she said a caretaker's job is not a job but a task, meaning something nobody thanks you for. To him the ⑤ task of opening the building at seven, in the dark, in every weather, was not a burden but the thing he was for, and the task of it never changed.

In 1994 the county set up a ⑥ task force on school safety, eleven people, and they ⑦ tasked my father with showing them round. He showed them the boiler, the eleven steps and the door that did not shut, and they wrote nothing down. When the report said the roof had been repaired in 1987 by the council, my mother ⑧ took him to task about it for a week, and he said he did not care who had the credit for a roof.

The ⑨ task he gave me, and the only one, was the notebook, and I kept it for one summer. He died in 2003. They planted a tree at the school and put his name on it, which he would have hated. The ⑩ task, I think now, was never the roof or the boiler or the door; it was to be there at seven, and he never once called it a task, and he was, for thirty-one years, in the dark.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 任务；职责；分内的事
B. n. 苦差事；没人感谢的活
C. n. （老师布置的）作业；任务
D. v. 交给……任务；指派（task sb with sth）
E. 固定搭配：take ... to task（for / over）责备；批评
F. 固定搭配：the task of doing ... 做……这件事情／任务
G. 固定搭配：an impossible / a huge task 不可能／艰巨的任务
H. 固定搭配：task force 特别工作组；专项小组

items.q: set us a task for the summer
My father's own task, as he saw it
was, everybody said, an impossible task
He never called it a task
the task of opening the building at seven
the county set up a task force
they tasked my father with showing them
my mother took him to task about it
The task he gave me, and the only one
The task, I think now, was never the roof

answers.why: a task 意为“（老师布置的）作业、任务”，老师给我们布置了一项暑假作业。
task 意为“任务、分内的事”，在他自己看来，他的任务是那栋校舍。
an impossible task 意为“不可能完成的、极其艰巨的任务”，大家都说开学前修好屋顶是不可能的事。
a task 意为“苦差事、没人感谢的活”，我母亲用这个词，指没人感谢你也停不下来的活。
the task of doing ... 意为“做……这件事、……的任务”，对他来说，早上七点开门这件事根本不是负担。
task force 意为“特别工作组、专项小组”，1994 年县里成立了一个校园安全专项小组。
tasked 是动词，意为“指派……任务”，他们指派父亲带他们看一圈，用了一个下午。
take ... to task 意为“责备、批评”，报告说屋顶是议会修的，母亲为此责备了他一个星期。
the task 意为“任务”，他交给我的唯一任务就是那个笔记本。
the task 意为“任务、分内的事”，如今我想，那任务从来不是屋顶、锅炉或那扇门。
